newsitem.title: USA: US stock fund flows surge in 3-day period - survey.
newsitem.headline: US stock fund flows surge in 3-day period - survey.

text.p: Cash flows into U.S. stock mutual funds surged to $1.49 billion for the three-day period ended March 6 versus $7 million for the two days ended March 3, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tab.

Aggressive growth funds took in $360 million compared with outflows of $140 million for the previous period, growth funds recorded inflows of $559 million versus $3 million, and growth and income funds posted inflows of $631 million versus $101 million, the fund tracker said.

Bond funds saw lower inflows to $60 million from $468 million. Government/GNMA funds had outflows of $60 million versus inflows of $115 million, and corporate/income/global funds had outflows of $57 million versus inflows of $46 million. Muni funds had inflows of $150 million versus inflows of $148 million.
